title: Users
description: Manage login accounts — staff, customers, admins — plus roles and account status.
name: Name
passwordHint: Leave blank to auto-generate a temporary password.
newPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password. Enter any password to change it.
setPasswordHint: Enter the new password for this account.
usernameUniqueHint: Must be unique — another account cannot already use this username.
passwordChanged: Password updated. Active sessions were signed out.
customerIdHint: Optional UUID linking a customer login.
linkedCustomerHint: Required for customer logins. That user only sees this customer's orders, quotes, invoices, and progress.
confirmDeactivate: Deactivate this user? They will not be able to sign in.
confirmActivate: Activate this user so they can sign in again?
confirmReset: Reset this user's password and revoke active sessions?
stageSkillsHint: Stages this worker can be assigned to on production orders.
noStagesYet: No stages in the library yet. Create stages in Workflow first.
